results.evidence: The schedule runs 5:00 AM to 1:30 PM (8.5 h) while the day and timing.summitTimeHrs say 10.5 h. Trip reports vary widely: one overnight party summited ~10 AM, was back at camp 3 PM and at the trailhead 6:30 PM; another took ~3 h summit-to-camp and ~5.5 h camp-to-car. No two sources agree on a camp-start summit-day duration, so the schedule times cannot be rebuilt; consistent published camp-to-summit and camp-to-trailhead times would settle it.

The April-May 'best in early season because of brush' statement is published for the Brothers Traverse (which shares the approach), while other South Couloir pages give only broad spring/summer/fall seasons or say the climb goes in all seasons with varying gear. No two South Couloir sources state the same optimal window; two agreeing route-specific statements (April-May vs late May-June) would settle it.

The Mountaineers route data say to leave the Dungeness trail before crossing the major stream from the Warrior/Inner Constance cirque and climb east staying north of the streambed. The SummitPost peak page instead describes continuing past the last, larger creek to a boulder field and then heading up and back left toward the creek under a cliff band to avoid bushwhacking. The two sources describe different lines and no third account says which side is correct, so the approach prose and the 'wrong side' test cannot be reconciled; a GPS track or a third independent account of the cirque approach would settle it.
